defaults.source_originality_policy: Independent implementation for external inspiration; external code or assets only after approval and applicable license, attribution, and notice review.
defaults.source_freshness_policy: Verify current primary sources before recording or using latest/current stable/unpinned versions; use version-scoped docs for pinned versions; use user-supplied material when network acquisition is not approved; check project-approved and framework-approved source registries before duplicate research.
defaults.version_control_policy: Use an existing repository when present; do not initialize or materially change version control without explicit approval.
defaults.backout_policy: Prefer the smallest reversible fix; destructive reset, data, migration, deployment, or history operations require explicit approval.
